title: I might have had a Mall World dream recently
content: So when it comes to my dream, it’s hard for me to remember specifics. Especially in the last 2 years because I had started… gardening… with my medical card, and that usually causes users not to dream (or not remember them) But I did have a short lucid dream recently that may have taken place in Mall World! All I can really remember was the start of the “Oh shit I’m dreaming” moment. I was in what I think was a convention center standing in front of a big wall that was just all glass. Not a standalone wall, it was as if I were in a convention area and the wall between the inside and the courtyard was just glass. And what was my first lucid dream activity? To throw a chair through the glass and walk through it. Outside in this courtyard area, the grass was very green. Like Florida summer green. The side walk was made of light pink… Not cobblestone but stone tiles? I think I also remember seeing a white stone fountain around or some sort of white stone piece. I can’t exactly remember if people were around, but if they were, they were probably like “Is this guy nuts?!” That’s what I would think if I saw someone randomly throw a chair through a glass wall and walk out of it. Anyway, does my environmental description sound familiar to anyone else?
